what: On first open, picks a day or night skin from the current time — day from 4:00 until before 21:00, night otherwise (data-theme on html=light|dark). Once chosen it stays for the session and is the same across pages. Pressing the attached check box (the small dot in the header row) flips night ↔ day, and other boxes using the same part follow along. Background and text color transition over 1.2s cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1)

options.from · to: Hour the day starts and ends (0–24), default 4 · 21
options.attr: Attribute set on html, default data-theme — the [data-theme in the Skin file=dark] block receives it
options.--fx-dur: Duration of the color transition (css variable), default 1.2s

use: — in theme.css, :root[data-theme=dark] { --kf-bg: …; --kf-ink: … }

from.where: shared.js day-night dot button (original [data-theme-switch] — sessionStorage dark-mode-settings, if absent new Date().getHours() of 4 or more and under 21 is light, html.dark-mode/light-mode, colors 1.2s cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1))

note: Skin values live in theme.css under [data-theme, not in the part=dark] block. If deciding day or night on open happens later than the first paint it flickers, so load the part script near the head or run the same rule inline first
